summary: System architecture for an Autonomous Gaming Sandbox platform. Instead of brittle pixel-based integrations with commercial games, the platform features a purpose-built headless simulation sandbox, a low-latency local controller for discrete action execution, and a decoupled high-level reasoning agent that queries an LLM intermittently alongside short- and long-term memory systems.

nodes.label: Web Client & Challenge Studio
nodes.description: User interface for authoring custom sandbox challenges, defining objectives, and spectating agent live runs via WebSocket stream.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.description: Manages routing, user authentication, rate limits, and live connection termination.

nodes.label: Challenge & Matchmaker Service
nodes.description: Validates user challenge parameters, tracks victory conditions, and provisions isolated sandbox instances.

nodes.label: Challenge & Score Store
nodes.description: Relational database storing challenge maps, rulesets, evaluation metrics, and agent leaderboards.

nodes.label: Headless Sandbox Engine
nodes.description: Deterministic simulation environment running physics, inventory, terrain generation, and object interactions.

nodes.label: Local State Filter & Controller
nodes.description: Buffers high-frequency engine ticks, aggregates symbolic state, and executes deterministic low-level pathfinding/actions.

nodes.label: State & Action Event Bus
nodes.description: Redis/Kafka broker handling state update broadcasts, action queues, and challenge completion events.

nodes.label: Agent Decision Orchestrator
nodes.description: Implements the Observe-Plan-Act loop; filters out redundant observations and triggers strategic reasoning when goals shift.

nodes.label: Episodic & Spatial Memory
nodes.description: Vector and key-value store maintaining terrain maps, historical attempts, and environmental knowledge across episodes.

nodes.label: LLM Reasoning Engine
nodes.description: Language and vision model invoked with structured context and tool definitions to produce macro action sequences.

edges.label: Spawn simulation container with rule spec

flowchart LR
  subgraph Client Tier
    UI[Web Client & Challenge Studio]
  end

  subgraph Management & Control
    GW[API Gateway]
    CS[Challenge & Matchmaker Service]
    CDB[(Challenge & Score Store)]
  end

  subgraph Simulation Runtime
    SANDBOX[Headless Sandbox Engine]
    LC[Local State Filter & Controller]
    BUS[(State & Action Event Bus)]
  end

  subgraph Autonomous Agent Brain
    AO[Agent Decision Orchestrator]
    MEM[(Episodic & Spatial Memory)]
    LLM[LLM Reasoning Engine]
  end

  UI -->|Submit challenge| GW
  GW --> CS
  CS --> CDB
  CS -->|Spawn session| SANDBOX
  SANDBOX -->|Raw tick updates| LC
  LC -->|Symbolic state| BUS
  BUS -->|State events| AO
  AO <-->|Context & map cache| MEM
  AO -->|State & tool prompt| LLM
  LLM -->|Macro action plan| AO
  AO -->|Queue macro actions| BUS
  BUS -->|Dispatch actions| LC
  LC -->|Execute engine inputs| SANDBOX
  SANDBOX -.->|Telemetry & render stream| UI
